listing.title: My First Birds Coloring Book
listing.subtitle: 30 Big & Easy Bird Pages – Owl, Parrot, Flamingo, Penguin & More for Kids Ages 2-5
listing.author: JONNY COLOR
listing.description_html:
Big, bold and easy to color: a first coloring book full of friendly birds!

Little hands color 30 cute birds, from a wise owl and a bright parrot to a pink flamingo and a waddling penguin. Every page has one big, simple picture with extra-thick lines, so small hands can color inside the lines.

Inside you'll find:

  • Farm birds: Chick, Hen, Rooster, Duck, Goose and Turkey
  • Backyard birds: Owl, Robin, Bluebird, Cardinal, Crow, Dove, Woodpecker and Hummingbird
  • Water birds: Swan, Flamingo, Pelican, Penguin, Puffin, Seagull and Stork
  • Wild and colorful birds: Parrot, Peacock, Toucan, Eagle, Ostrich and Kiwi
  • Plus a Bird Nest with eggs, a Birdhouse and a Hatching Chick
  • One large picture per page with thick outlines, and each name in big letters to color
  • Single-sided pages with a blank back, so markers won't bleed onto the next picture
  • Big 8.5 x 11 inch pages and a "Great job!" certificate at the end

A fun, screen-free activity for toddlers and preschoolers ages 2 to 5.

Part of the my first step series.
